gaps.title: Uniques have no mods or base type
gaps.text: `uniques` and `unique_details` give the name, class, art and flavour text of 449 uniques. No file says which base or which mods a unique has. 10,447 mods have `generation_type: "unique"`, and `mods_by_base` lists them per class and tag set, not per unique.

gaps.title: inherits_from points at files that are not exported

gaps.title: Two spellings of item class

gaps.title: Two gem path spellings
gaps.text: Gem ids start with `Metadata/Items/Gem/` (595) or `Metadata/Items/Gems/` (594). Match the exact string. Do not normalise it.

gaps.title: Hidden stats
gaps.text: 3,976 of 26,082 stat references in `mods` have no text in any `stat_translations` file, for example `local_weapon_implicit_hidden_%_base_damage_is_fire`. The game does not show them.

gaps.title: mods_by_base values are levels
gaps.text: Each number is the mod’s `required_level` (86,660 of 86,660 agree). `spawn_weights` are only 0 or 1 in this game: a tag allows a mod or blocks it.

gaps.title: Some jewel slots point nowhere
gaps.text: 12 of 31 `jewel_slots` name a passive that is in no exported tree.

gaps.title: Text is often already rendered
gaps.text: `mods.text`, `base_items.implicit_text`, skill `stat_text` and passive `stat_text` hold finished lines with ranges. You need `stat_translations` only to render a rolled value.

gaps.title: skill_gems is keyed by gem id

gaps.title: Gem attribute requirements are not stored
gaps.text: `requirements` holds only the level for each gem level. The game derives Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence from `requirement_weights`, and no file holds that formula.

gaps.title: Some skill references use the inner id

gaps.title: mods_by_base values are levels
